verdict.rationale: First-party pages say Jeeves pays vendors, employees, and contractors in bulk across 150+ countries and 40+ currencies with no transfer or wire fees. They also cite mid-market rates on Instant Pay and no setup or recurring fees, which together cover local-currency international payments with a fairly transparent fee story. However, other wording such as "competitive FX rates" leaves the actual FX margin vague. Missing for 10: a published fee/FX-markup schedule or per-payment fee disclosure, clarity on whether mid-market rates apply beyond the stablecoin rail currencies, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
